title: Spatial Selection Per Model And State
description: Replace adhoc flat selection arrays with per-model-definition renderer selection and per-interaction-state selection maps.
summary: Introduced SpatialRendererSelectionByModel and SpatialInteractionSelectionByState. InteractionRepl and play host preserve selection when switching model definitions; interaction states keep isolated highlight slices synced from context.targets. Removed play selection clears on model switch and model revision. 23/23 @spatial/js-renderer-r3f tests pass.
